headline_seed: US attacks Iran as Houthis allow Chinese ships to pass: What’s the latest? - Al Jazeera
draft_text:
Two Chinese supertankers carrying Saudi crude cleared the Bab el-Mandeb strait despite the Houthi naval blockade, per LSEG vessel-tracking data cited by Newsweek and Reuters.

Multiple other tankers turned back earlier this week.

And that's the mews.
